pr_title: Support flattened fields and multi-fields as dimensions in downsampling
pr_comment: Hi @lkts, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Hi @lkts, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: Can you come up with a scenario when flattened field can be a multi-field? Cause right now this does not support that.

I can't think of a scenario. A flattened field isn't a leaf field, but an object field that gets indexed as if it is a leaf field. So you can indexing it into a single numeric and keyword field via multi fields isn't possible.
